{{Quote|It will be a glorious day.''"<br />"''And then we will turn our attention fully to the two planets of Dubrillion and Destrillion.''"<br />"''And then we will reach further to the core of the galaxy. The yammosk and I have foreseen it. As for those two planets, we will use them for our resource needs, and perhaps create our second base upon one.|[[Ma'Shraid]], [[Dooje Brolo]] and [[Da'Gara]]|<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>}}
'''Destrillion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Dubrillion system/Legends|Dubrillion system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in close proximity to [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] and the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] of [[Lando's Folly]]. It was a barren world with a turbulent [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and appeared [[Color/Legends|brown]] and dirty from [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. It also contained various energy tunnels as well as an energy field containing a [[tibanna gas platform]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Mission to Destrillion]] post-cedes the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], led by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], was sent there to [[Mission to Destrillion|investigate]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] research facility, but found nothing but several [[TIE/hu "Hunter" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Hunters]] defending an Imperial supply [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]]; the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] would later discover the facility on Dubrillion.<ref name="RS III" />

[[24 ABY/Legends|Twenty-one years later]], when [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] came to Dubrillion to find a new way to mine asteroids, he built several ore processing plants in the upper atmosphere of Destrillion. It was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy, forcing the inhabitants to evacuate to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
Destrillion first appeared in [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|The New Jedi Order]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''.
